limitations: No authorized ROMAN source corpus is currently admitted as source evidence.
Live multi-session orchestration and transactional concurrent mutation are not established.
falsification_conditions: Fresh session cannot discover ROMAN from current registry and contract.
Generated text is admitted as authentic source evidence.
A stale writer overwrites newer ROMAN state.
ROMAN changes another mission identity or global voice.
A source claim cannot be traced to source and passage.
recovery_policy: Preserve state and conflicts; bootstrap from canonical contract and this state file.
retirement_policy: Retirement preserves state, provenance, contributions and historical outputs.
